title: Each open PR carries its state on GitHub, and a sweep names the ones without
why: Owner ask, 12:17 CST Nov 7: "How many PRs are sitting idle that haven't merged because you lost track ... mechanize this better, this is an obvious gap." Measured by the coordinator at 12:24 CST: 36 open claude-settings PRs and 16 q_max PRs are named in neither its handoff nor runner 8's queue; #1371 (git mailbox, round 3 PASS Nov 6) is one.
note: Waits on step pr-tracking-root-cause for its mechanism. Each open PR carries a state on GitHub (for example queue, held, parked, replaced), each state with an age limit. Done check: red when a PR's state is older than its limit (queued with no batch after one cycle; held or parked with no page item or debt), and red on a PR with no state; a label alone is not the test. Each coordinator and batch-runner report gives two numbers, gold 0: the longest wait from passed review to merge, and the count of open PRs with no next act. Also: a session's report lists an on-merge PR that has waited longer than one batch cycle under Deviations, never under Next.
